text: The word "HODL" started as a typo for "hold" in a 2013 BitcoinTalk post — and it stuck forever.
Pizza Day celebrates May 22, 2010, when 10,000 BTC bought two pizzas — one of crypto's most expensive lunches.
Satoshi Nakamoto's identity is still unknown — and their early BTC has barely moved for years.
Dogecoin began as a joke meme coin in 2013 and later powered charity drives and NASCAR sponsorships.
Ethereum's first major crowdfunding raised about $18M in 2014 — long before "DeFi summer" was a thing.
"WAGMI" and "NGMI" became crypto slang for whether a trade (or life choice) will age well.
Bitcoin's genesis block included a newspaper headline about bank bailouts — a timestamp and a statement.
NFT profile pictures once sold for more than some cars — then many floors cooled as the joke matured.
